recoveredFacts: Default mode0 has an empty attack ability: the Holographic Mirage cannot attack. Modes1 and3 have single-target Physical attacks for ground/air; mode2 is empty during return.

Original trait uses substitute range x-1 and duration20. Mode1/3 fatal path removes the undeadable guard instead of initiating another substitute; it must not inherit indefinite Bena/Kazemaru fatal cycling.

Talent ON_TAKE_DAMAGE filters ENEMY modifier sources, attaches selected Fragile and timed Invisibility immunity to the attacker, finishes the talent buff, then calls TriggerSkill(checkBeforeTrigger=false); an unsuccessful trigger calls iana[switch2stand]. Whether a manual S2 that is unready is cast/refused is not resolved by the node alone.

SwitchBegin clears non-durable buffs while retaining the named trait/skills; SwitchEnd retains block-zero and substitute countdown. Original transitions heal via MAX_HP ratio1 and clear SP; the mode is changed by completion passives, not by the first incoming-hit frame.

S1 passive all10ranks has atk_scale2.6..4. On original Doll_Skill_1_SwitchIn event .067, StandBorn actions trigger S1Attack. Native S1Attack contains HitEnemy filtered by iana_t_1 marker and HitSelf fallback. Both emit projectile_chr_iana_s1, speed5 parabolic, reach delay .2 and stop-only unlimited ground/air area selection. No explicit explosion radius/rangeId is serialized in its FixedRange-like selector.

S2 all10ranks retains source SPcost8..5/init4/duration8..10 and ASPD200..300. Its switch reaches mode3, uses original Doll_Skill_2_SwitchIn event .2 and attaches own Invisibility/ASPD and an enemy Invisibility-immunity aura. The aura removes its recipient buff when they leave or when detached; it must not become a permanent snapshot reveal.

Ordinary substitute projectile speed30 lifetime10 selects one ground/air target. Both normal and S2 native animation controllers have first-only Attack_Begin .167, Attack_Loop .8 with OnAttack .1, Attack_End .667, uncapped scaling and explicit Down overrides.
Both operator skeletons match original chararts PPtr chains and the independently pinned resource Git blobs. Missing Back outgoing/death/Down clips are not invented.
holdReasons: Material damage/skill dispatch remains unverified: native TriggerSkill(checkBeforeTrigger=false) return semantics and ON_TAKE_DAMAGE/fatal ordering determine whether an incoming attack automatically casts manual S2, consumes SP while unready, or instead enters ordinary substitute. Implementing only button activation would omit this native branch.

S1 explosion selector has no serialized radius/rangeId in the recovered graph or skill blackboard. The substitute x-1 range does not prove projectile AoE geometry. Marker targeting, fallback choice and stop callback ordering also need native controller recovery or measured game evidence.

Exact first-only Begin/Loop/End cooldown phases, SwitchEnd completion origin, S2 buff start versus skill countdown and aura sampling are compiled. Full graph retention and original animation events constrain a future adapter but do not establish frame parity.
No combat support is enabled from this evidence. Recover dispatch and blast geometry before adding the full Iana kit; do not report art availability as playable coverage.
